> The CSCC 2-3 subdomain sets fixed cadences.

Patch external, internet-facing critical systems at least monthly, and internal systems at least quarterly, with critical vulnerabilities remediated as soon as possible (control 2-3-1-3). Harden systems to a secure baseline, and review that configuration and hardening at least every six months (2-3-1-6). Remove hard-coded, backdoor, and default passwords entirely (2-3-1-7).
